---
# No title, subtitle or author: Quarto only emits a title slide when one of
# those is set, and this deck deliberately opens straight onto blank paper.
#
# Everything below is a stack of empty slides. Each empty level-two heading
# starts one and carries a permanent id; Pandoc omits the empty heading itself,
# so nothing is typeset on the page. Add another uniquely numbered heading at
# the end to add a page.
#
# Ink is stored under those ids, so adding or rearranging pages does not move
# existing working onto another slide. The drawing tools are available as soon
# as the deck opens.
#
# Deck-wide settings (theme, drawing plugin, dimensions) live in _quarto.yml.
---
